entries.title: Institutional response visibility upgrade
entries.summary: Event pages now promote substantive public institutional responses into a dedicated section, while generic dataset disclaimer text is filtered out of event, school, and brief response surfaces.

entries.title: Press and journalist reporting surfaces
entries.summary: Added a press brief, a journalist use guide, and a findings memo so reporters can inspect the archive, cite it more carefully, and understand what the current snapshot does and does not support.

entries.title: Reviewer brief and packet
entries.summary: Added a short public reviewer brief and a markdown packet so outside organizations, researchers, and advisors can critique the project through a narrow, documented review path.

entries.title: Research workspace and reviewer queue
entries.summary: Shipped a citation-packet builder, a reviewer queue, and filtered export paths so the archive is easier to audit, cite, and route into structured review work.

entries.title: School dossiers and public briefs
entries.summary: Expanded the archive beyond record listings with school dossier pages, source pages, and a published briefs surface tied to explicit dataset snapshots.

entries.title: Submission packet generators
entries.summary: Added source-submission, correction, duplicate, and metadata packet generators so contributors can prepare structured GitHub-ready issues without needing an account or backend.

entries.title: Public MVP launch
entries.summary: Published the initial static-first archive with source-backed event records, school coverage, dataset downloads, methodology notes, and reproducible snapshot artifacts.
